replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is one of my favorite subjects. I find it logical and satisfying. Though I studied only up to upper secondary, I enjoy solving problems and understanding concepts. It's like a puzzle that makes sense to me.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. I enjoy math, so I don't get anxious. My moderate neuroticism helps—I stay calm. But I do dislike physics and economics, which are more confusing to me. Still, math is my go-to subject.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI math tutor app last year. It helped me practice algebra and geometry. The step-by-step explanations were great, and I felt more confident. It was user-friendly and not overwhelming.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation as ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, check if it's factorable. If not, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). Plug in the numbers, calculate the discriminant, and solve for x. It's like following a recipe.

First, find the first derivative f'(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. These are critical points. Then, take the second derivative f''(x) and plug in the critical points. If f''(x) > 0, it's a minimum; if < 0, it's a maximum. Simple and logical.
